registry.name: Uttar Pradesh Revenue Council / Prayagraj district land-records service
registry.scope: Official Prayagraj district material directs users to the Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh land-record service; the state Revenue Council portal documents Bhulekh and Bhu-Naksha services. This is custodian/procedure evidence, not proof of a citywide parcel API.

queries.query: India official cadastral parcel map API Uttar Pradesh Phaphamau Prayagraj
queries.result: Found the official Uttar Pradesh Revenue Council portal, official UP Bhulekh/Bhu-Naksha viewer, official Prayagraj land-records page, and a current public state Bhu-Naksha service. The viewer's public map extent for the Phaphamau revenue-village code was zero, so no parcel geometry was retained.

exactPointCheck.method: Public viewer route inspection for the exact WUP point [25.5330358267187, 81.8535950796536] in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift and no synthetic parcel lookup.
exactPointCheck.result: The official level-value response identified Phaphamau (फाफामऊ), village code 218785, with hasData=false. getGisCodeFromLevels returned 0917500888, and getVVVVExtentGeoref returned xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax all 0.0. This map extent miss is not evidence of citywide absence.

uncertainty: The official state viewer and current JavaScript/API routes were inspected anonymously. Level discovery succeeded, but the target village was explicitly marked hasData=false and its map extent was zero.
No exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI was treated as citywide absence; a neighboring revenue village or a later digitization update could expose different coverage.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, sale, mutation, or litigation fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration or runtime adapter admission.
